title: Camp Sight | Retreat next to Camp WaterColor| Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Camp Sight is a pet-friendly WaterColor home overlooking Camp WaterColor, featuring a private carriage house, bikes, a golf cart, and full resort access.
description_expanded: Camp Sight Features - Overlooks Camp WaterColor! Access included with your reservation - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, and non-aggressive breeds only. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - Complimentary use of a 6-seater LSV (golf cart). Must sign a waiver for access to the LSV - Access to 5 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape - Driveway parking for 3 vehicles (garage parking not available) - Private Carriage House Apartment with sleeping for up to 4 guests, a full kitchen, living room, and private entrance as well as access to the main house from the 2nd floor patio walkover. - Outdoor grill on 2nd floor deck - 2nd Floor Main living area with Smart TV and multiple entrances to the covered balcony with lots of cushioned seating plus outdoor dining for 4 - 2nd Floor Gourmet Kitchen with professional grade stainless steel appliances - 2nd Floor Dining table with seating for 8 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 - 1st Floor Family Room with Smart TV - Cable and WIFI throughout home - Covered front porch with rocking chairs and cushioned bench swing with view of Camp WaterColor - Covered balcony with seating and views of Camp WaterColor - Sundeck on the 2nd floor with outdoor dining for 6, outdoor grill, and walkover access to carriage house apartment - Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and community pools included for 12 guests age 5 and older - Community pools heated during cooler months (subject to change by the neighborhood) - Concierge services including baby equipment rentals, grocery delivery, boat charters, and beach service available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Welcome to Camp Sight! Our designer home is ideally located across from Camp WaterColor and is perfect for families to vacation in style. Situated on a corner lot, the expansive home features a deluxe wrap around balcony with outdoor seating, outdoor dining, an outdoor grill, and walkover to the carriage house apartment. There are additional private outdoor spaces on the covered patio, courtyard between the main house and carriage house, side patio, and front balcony. Camp Sight celebrates the outdoor lifestyle that makes WaterColor and 30A a must visit vacation destination. This home is loaded with extras, including a 6-seater LSV (golf cart), 5 taxi bikes, and multiple living rooms. The spacious floor plan is comfortable and inviting for your crew of up to 14. The private carriage house is also a perfect space for anyone in your family who desires a bit more privacy. This luxurious private space even includes a Full Kitchen! ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite | ensuite bath with combination shower/tub
1st Floor King Guest Room | hallway access to shared full bath with walk-in shower
1st Floor Bunk Room | Sleeps 4 in two Twin over Twin bunks, hallway access to shared full bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor King Suite | TV, ensuite bath with jetted tub and walk-in shower
Carriage House Queen Guest Room | full bath with combination shower/tub
Bonus | Queen Sleeper Sofa in carriage house living room

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
